entities.name: Precinct One
entities.description: The opulent heart of Ravnica in the Tenth District, where grand architecture and gardens display the city's wealth.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The city-plane whose civilization Precinct One showcases.

entities.name: Tenth District
entities.description: District of Ravnica containing Precinct One.

entities.name: Azorius Senate
entities.description: Guild that staffs Precinct One with administrators, enforcers and lawmakers, keeping constant watch.

entities.name: Orzhov Syndicate
entities.description: Guild that owns many clubs and dining establishments and the guildhall Orzhova and Vizkopa Bank.

entities.name: Selesnya Conclave
entities.description: Guild that tends the precinct's grounds and acts as diplomatic intermediary.

entities.name: Orzhova
entities.description: The Syndicate's ornate guildhall, housing the Obzedat spirits.

entities.name: Vizkopa Bank
entities.description: The Orzhov's financial stronghold and mint, protected by gargoyles.

entities.name: Chamber of the Guildpact
entities.description: Grand hall where Ravnica's guilds meet; the Living Guildpact keeps an office here.

entities.name: Gateway Plaza
entities.description: Open space created when the Planar Bridge destroyed buildings near the Chamber of the Guildpact.

entities.name: Tenth District Plaza
entities.description: Neutral plaza at the heart of the precinct, once the site of Bolas's Citadel and the God-Pharaoh's Statue.

entities.name: Bolas's Citadel
entities.description: Structure located in Tenth District Plaza during the War of the Spark.

entities.name: War of the Spark
entities.description: The war during which the Planar Bridge destroyed buildings around the Chamber of the Guildpact.

entities.name: Ravnican Agency of Magicological Investigations
entities.description: Agency with a floating headquarters shaped like an eye.

events.summary: During the War of the Spark the Planar Bridge destroys the buildings around the Chamber of the Guildpact, creating Gateway Plaza.
events.quote: an open space created when the Planar Bridge destroyed the buildings around the Chamber of the Guildpact during the War of the Spark

relations.quote: Orzhova, the Syndicate's ornate guildhall, also called the Church of Deals
Located in the mid-southern part of the Tenth District
